description: Full-scale fork of exp352 with upper-graded out_proj tph [2048, 2048, 1024, 1024, 512, 512]. Sum=7168 (+17% over exp351's 6144). Tests whether adding capacity where distill difficulty shows it's needed (layers 0-1 hardest at sign_acc=0.887-0.93) and removing it from late layers (layer 5 at 0.986) improves over uniform tph=1024. Total ~237M bit weights (~29.6 MB bit-packed).
